problem_statement: A system with RISC-V PMP memory-attribute regions (configured via the device tree and CONFIG_MEM_ATTR) has no way to change the R/W/X permissions of an already-programmed PMP region while running. Add a runtime API that, given a memory-attribute region index and a new R/W/X permission mask, locates the PMP entry matching that region's start address and size and rewrites its permission bits, returning 0 on success, -EINVAL when the permission mask contains bits outside the R/W/X set or the region index is out of range, and -ENOENT when no PMP entry matches the region.
